title: 第二十一章 别离第二十二章 终分别
lines: 第二十一章别离
夜天云的精神力极为庞大，只是没有得到指点，没得到正确的使用方法，因此才无法利用其随意感知周围的状况。此时得到了幽夜的教导，便如同山洪蓄谷，得知了如何引入宣泄通道。
只是，即便是开闸泄洪尚且需要时日，更何况运用晦涩玄奥与灵魂相关的精神力，此时夜天云所能感应的范围并不广泛，大约是半径五米的一个圆圈。
“精神力源自于灵魂力，就叫它魂知吧。”夜天云心想道。
魂知便如同雷达一般覆盖着周身五米的区域，无论是桌椅板凳，还是人物走动，甚至连查克拉波动都能感知的一清二楚，跟白眼有些相似，但范围就小的多了。
夜天云获得了魂知后，并没有懈怠，再次投身到修炼之中。幽夜为他敲响了一个警钟，本身的实力若不强，即便拥有在强大的外力辅助，也不过是外强中干罢了。
螺旋丸的开发暂时停滞，只有靠时间来打磨，夜天云也就转而钻研其他方面。
忍术方面，夜天云将重点放在了开发千鸟上。千鸟是查克拉性质变化的极致，无需考虑形态的完美，只消修炼出精纯的雷属性性质变化即可，对于已经掌握了雷属性炼体的夜天云，开创千鸟的难度自然要小于螺旋丸。
没过几个星期，夜天云便已将千鸟还原了出来，当然这一切都是夜天云暗中独自钻研。
自来也不擅长幻术，夜天云也不在训练自己的幻术。况且夜天云的精神力强大，一般的幻术无法对他造成影响，即便会有影响，在魂知的感应下一切都会现出原形。
体术方面，夜天云倒想改变下修行的方向。夜天云有着自己独有的身法，虽然正在改进，但仍旧是技巧有余，爆发性的力量则是不足。
只是体术非一日之功，那是经过十数个寒暑的苦练方能显效，为了尽快拥有不俗的体术，他想到了原著中的一门强大的体术禁术——八门遁甲。
开门、休门、生门、伤门、杜门、景门、惊门和死门，此八门为人体的内八门，平时如同闸门一样为经络中的查克拉设下限制，一旦开启，便会引出比原本强上数十倍的绝招，不过获得力量的同时，施术者本身极有可能受到严重的损伤。
虽然风险极大，但若是控制得当，对身体的损伤也不会十分严重，因此夜天云决定设法获知八门遁甲的方法。
“自来也老师，有没有获得强大体术的捷径？”夜天云问道。
“八门遁甲的里莲华，不过这可是木叶禁术，一旦使用，非死即伤。”自来也并没有隐瞒。
“既然是禁术，那么威力一定不差吧。”夜天云说道。
“不错，八门齐开后，短时间内可获得远超于我的力量，但是之后，施术者必亡。”自来也顺着夜天云的话，解答道，不过提到副作用时，语气稍重，显然是不希望夜天云修行这种禁术。
“那么，若是只开启一门，会如何？”夜天云问道。不过却心想：“看来有可能成功。”
“只会增加查克拉的流速，获得瞬间的爆发力罢了，副作用不大。”话一出口，自来也便见夜天云笑吟吟的看着自己。
“那么自来也老师就不必担心了，我有分寸。”夜天云此话一出，令自来也恍然大悟。
自来也不授予夜天云里莲华就是因为开启八门后副作用太过剧烈，但刚刚自己却说过开启一门并没有太大的损害，现在自己也不好拒绝夜天云的请求。
“好吧，我可以交给你，只是你要保证，无论如何，绝对不可以开启第三门——生门，因为开启三门后，便正式踏入了里莲华的境地。”自来也的表情有些无奈。
“知道了，老师。”夜天云欣喜异常。
得到了八门遁甲的修炼方法，夜天云满心欢喜的离去了，自来也看着夜天云欢喜的背影，嘴角挂起一抹笑容。
八门遁甲，是木叶体术流的禁忌奥义，自来也自然有权利拒绝夜天云的请求，但他却佯装上当，将其传授给了夜天云，可见，自来也是如此的在意夜天云。
一个师傅，若碰到了一个近乎完美的徒弟，自然会想法设法在修行上满足徒弟的任何需要。
夜天云钟于八门遁甲自不是单单为了暂时性的获得强大的力量，而是有着独有的想法，将八门永久的打开。
不过，开启八门需要雄厚的查克拉，夜天云的查克拉虽然精纯，远胜于常人，但目前来看还无法做到支撑开门的永久性开启，因此夜天云的修炼时期积攒的查克拉全部汇在开门处，厚积薄发，有朝一日定能冲破开门的关隘。
体术方面夜天云自然不能落下他的立足之本，刀术。本来夜天云打算请教幽夜，但这个想法一出现脑海中便被立即否决。幽夜之前的教导，夜天云可是铭记于心。若是自己一味的依赖幽夜，不但自己不能成为真正的强者，也会被幽夜看轻。
第二十一章别离
不过刀术的要领在于一个“悟”字，为此，夜天云请求自来也在白日时独自修炼，傍晚时分在回归，以方便他感悟刀意与刀法的结合。

Chapter 21 Farewell
Ye Tianyun's mental power is extremely huge, but he has not been given guidance or the correct way to use it, so he cannot use it to sense the surrounding situation at will. At this time, after receiving You Ye's teachings, it was like a mountain torrent accumulating a valley, knowing how to introduce a cathartic channel.
However, even if it takes time to open the gate to release the flood, not to mention using the obscure and mysterious spiritual power related to the soul, the range that Ye Tianyun can sense at this time is not wide, it is about a circle with a radius of five meters.
"Spiritual power comes from soul power, let's call it soul knowledge." Ye Tianyun thought to himself.
Soul Knowledge is like a radar covering an area of ​​five meters around the body. Whether it is tables, chairs, benches, people moving, or even chakra fluctuations, it can be clearly sensed. It is somewhat similar to the Byakugan, but the range is much smaller.
After Ye Tianyun obtained soul knowledge, he did not slack off and devoted himself to cultivation again. You Ye sounded a wake-up call for him. If he is not strong himself, even if he has strong external assistance, he is just a weak person.
The development of the Rasengan was temporarily stalled and could only be polished by time, so Ye Tianyun turned to other aspects.
In terms of ninjutsu, Ye Tianyun focused on developing Chidori. The Chidori is the ultimate in chakra property changes. There is no need to consider the perfection of the form, as long as the pure thunder attribute property changes are cultivated. For Ye Tianyun who has mastered the thunder attribute body refining, the difficulty of creating a Chidori is naturally less than that of the Rasengan.
Within a few weeks, Ye Tianyun had restored Chidori. Of course, Ye Tianyun studied all of this in secret.
Jiraiya is not good at genjutsu, and Ye Tianyun is no longer training his own genjutsu. Moreover, Ye Tianyun's mental power is so strong that ordinary illusions cannot affect him. Even if it does, everything will show its original shape under the induction of soul knowledge.
In terms of physical skills, Ye Tianyun wanted to change the direction of practice. Ye Tianyun has his own unique movement skills. Although he is improving, his skills are still sufficient, but his explosive power is insufficient.
It's just that physical skills are not accomplished in a day. They can only be effective after more than ten days of hard training in cold and summer. In order to have good physical skills as soon as possible, he thought of a powerful forbidden physical skill in the original book - Eight Gate Dunjia.
These eight gates are the eight inner gates of the human body. They are the eight inner gates of the human body. They are usually like gates that set limits for the chakra in the meridians. Once opened, a trick that is dozens of times stronger than the original one will be unleashed. However, while gaining power, the caster himself is very likely to be seriously injured.
Although the risk is extremely high, if it is controlled properly, the damage to the body will not be very serious, so Ye Tianyun decided to try to learn the method of Eight Gate Dunjia.
"Teacher Jiraiya, is there a shortcut to obtain powerful physical skills?" Ye Tianyun asked.
"Ura Renka of the Eight Gate Dungeon, but this is Konoha's forbidden technique. Once used, it will cause death or injury." Jiraiya did not hide it.
"Since it is a forbidden technique, it must be quite powerful." Ye Tianyun said.
"Yes, after the eight gates are opened together, you can gain power far beyond mine in a short period of time, but after that, the caster will die." Jiraiya followed Ye Tianyun's words and answered, but when he mentioned the side effects, his tone was a little stronger, obviously because he did not want Ye Tianyun to practice such forbidden techniques.
"Then, what will happen if only one door is opened?" Ye Tianyun asked. But I thought to myself: "It seems possible to succeed."
"It will only increase the flow rate of chakra and gain instant explosive power. It will have little side effects." As soon as the words came out, Jiraiya saw Ye Tianyun looking at him with a smile.
"Then Teacher Jiraiya, there is no need to worry, I have a sense of propriety." As soon as Ye Tianyun said these words, Jiraiya suddenly realized.
Jiraiya granted Ye Tianyun the Lotus Flower because the side effects of opening the eight gates were too severe, but he had just said that opening one gate would not cause much harm, and now he could not refuse Ye Tianyun's request.
"Okay, I can leave it to you, but you have to promise that no matter what, you will never open the third gate - the Life Gate, because after opening the third gate, you will officially enter Ura Renka's situation." Jiraiya's expression was a little helpless.
"I know, teacher." Ye Tianyun was extremely happy.
After obtaining the eight-door Dunjia training method, Ye Tianyun left happily. Jiraiya looked at Ye Tianyun's happy back with a smile on his lips.
Eight Gate Dungeon is a taboo secret of Konoha Taijutsu. Jiraiya naturally has the right to refuse Ye Tianyun's request, but he pretends to be fooled and teaches it to Ye Tianyun. It can be seen that Jiraiya cares about Ye Tianyun so much.
If a master meets a nearly perfect disciple, he will naturally find ways to meet any needs of the disciple in practice.
Ye Tianyunzhong's Eight Gate Dunjia was not just to temporarily gain powerful power, but he had a unique idea to open the Eight Gates permanently.
However, opening the eight gates requires strong chakra. Although Ye Tianyun's chakra is pure and far better than ordinary people, it is currently unable to support the permanent opening of the door. Therefore, all the chakra accumulated by Ye Tianyun during his training period is gathered at the door. With a thick accumulation, he will be able to break through the door one day.
In terms of physical skills, Ye Tianyun naturally cannot leave behind his foundation, sword skills. Ye Tianyun originally planned to ask You Ye for advice, but the idea was immediately rejected as soon as it came to his mind. Ye Tianyun kept You Ye's previous teachings in mind. If I blindly rely on You Ye, not only will I not be able to become a truly strong person, but I will also be looked down upon by You Ye.
Chapter 21 Farewell
However, the key to sword technique lies in the word "enlightenment". For this reason, Ye Tianyun asked Jiraiya to practice alone during the day and return in the evening, so that he could understand the combination of sword intention and sword technique.
